notes.title: Achievments and Hints
notes.notes: This update adds Steam Achievements and includes more hints to move players in the right direction. Its a great time to play Mars 2055.

notes.title: Mars 2055 - Hello darkness my old friend
notes.notes:
This update add the following:

[list]
[*] Ladder footsteps audio. • New fog. • Re-spawn points. 
[*] Oxygen depletion. • O2 bubble zones. • Second replacement suit. 
[*] New Space Station. • O2 refill in orbit. • Look damping. 
[*] New floating creature. • New interact retical. • HUD scaling. 
[*] More on boarding hints. • Interaction hints • Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Key codes, random locations, Christmas goodness
notes.notes: The final release of the year brings the implementation of key codes, find them, use them, and random pickup location so that a walkthru does not provide all the answer. Plus a good helping of Christmas goodness. Get it while its hot.

notes.title: Respawn Points and Dome Puzzles
notes.notes: This update introduces respawn points to automatically place you near the last place you were at on the map should you quit and restart or die. It also includes a new puzzle that needs to be solved on the lower level of the Dome.

notes.title: More improvements based on community feedback
notes.notes: Fix a bug where status text was being smeared. Improve the reactor restart puzzle. Add another lava fall. Improve the lab puzzle. Fix a collider bug on Geyser flats. Add Mars Quakes. Implement sliding and remove all invisible barriers. Add the drilling platform collapse and lava rising puzzle. Move the HUD out of the way rather than hiding it. Improve and expand the spare part puzzle. Improve the suit O2 mechanic.

notes.title: Something new on the horizon
notes.notes: Add more clues for the reactor restart. Open the engineering door without main power but add on boarding tips that suggest the player figure that puzzle out.  Change the plant animation and have them hide and show. Add a particle effect to plants showing and hiding. Open a new play area: Geyser Flats and introduce a new character.

notes.title: Mars 2055 v3 Release
notes.notes:
It's finally here! I've been watching [b]streamers[/b] play the game and I've been listening intently to their feedback. A [b]lot[/b] of that feedback has been incorporated into this release making the on boarding and puzzle experience event better. 

One of the biggest changes is a built in feedback form so you can send your thoughts directly to me.

If you have been waiting to grab Mars 2055 this is the event that you have been waiting for. If you are new to the game you found it at the right time. Spread the word.

notes.title: Major Update to v3.0.0
notes.notes: This is a major update from v2.x.x to v3.x.x with all kinds of changes from new on boarding to better lighting. The best thing I can suggest is that you try it out and send us feedback using the integrated feedback feature. We will continue to listen and improve the game.

notes.title: Update with new puzzles and UI
notes.notes: Fix a problem that made it difficult to pick up the energy cell. For now, don't require active HAL for inventory. Indicate the fence first is the wrong direction. Fix the Alien ship floor. Move dish control to the top of the ridge and fence the area. Add more clues to the location of reactor maintenance. Fix NonStop Q branding. Add no signal hint in Comms. Add in game settings for volume and quit. Widen ladders to make them easier to climb.

notes.title: Major update with many changes and improvements
notes.notes:
Add and change the following:
[list]
[*] add heads up display
[*] add AI
[*] add inventory
[*] simplify one aspect of the communications puzzle
[*] change how key cards are used
[*] new UI theme
[*] add multi hit damage system
[*] add ambient noise zones
[*] more enemies
[*] more lava
[*] new shader for animated sky with sun and sky with stars
[*] create ladder mechanic and replace some stairs with ladders
[*] make the reactor puzzle more challenging
[*] make the O2 puzzle more challenging
[*] several performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Winter 2022 Update
notes.notes: Add volumetric lighting. Add lava pools. Add lava falls. Add Martian plants.

notes.title: Halloween 2022 Update
notes.notes: Added some spooky / scary content just in time for Halloween

notes.title: More complex first scene
notes.notes: Make the first scene more complex to solve so that its a bit more fun.

notes.title: Add support for Game Controller
notes.notes: This update adds support for game controllers, including PS3 wired controllers on macOS, as well as movement and look hints.
